en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a rocky grotto and pond within a landscaped park. Trees and shrubs surround jagged rock formations; steps lead up through the rocks and there is a small waterfall or dark opening at the water's edge. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the location, with handwritten cursive text filling the bottom and running along the side and top borders.
